fields.label: Per Call
fields.description: How often partners may call: one bucket per partner, and one shared by all partners.

fields.label: Window (seconds)
fields.description: The period both call rates are measured over. The bucket refills smoothly across it, never at once.

fields.label: Partner Rate (calls/window)
fields.description: Calls one partner may keep making each window. At 120 per 60 seconds that is 2 a second. 0 removes it.

fields.label: Partner Burst (calls)
fields.description: Calls one partner may fire at once after a quiet spell. Blank allows 240; it is never below the rate.

fields.label: Global Rate (calls/window)
fields.description: Calls all partners together may keep making each window. Refused with a 503, not a 429. 0 removes it.

fields.label: Global Burst (calls)
fields.description: Calls all partners may fire at once after a quiet spell. Blank allows 600; it is never below the rate.

fields.label: Bulk Calls
fields.description: A separate bucket for bulk writes and every *_list read, so paging a long list is paced here.

fields.label: Bulk Window (seconds)
fields.description: The period the bulk rate is measured over. At 1 per 5 seconds, a second bulk write within 5 is refused.

fields.label: Bulk Rate (calls/window)
fields.description: Bulk writes one partner may make each bulk window. Bulk reads and lists are not counted. 0 removes it.

fields.label: Bulk Burst (calls)
fields.description: Pinned at 1: two bulk writes at once deadlock on the lead index. Raise the bulk rate for more room.

fields.label: Rows Over Time
fields.description: How much data partners may move, apart from how often they call. A bulk call is charged every row.

fields.label: Volume Window (seconds)
fields.description: The period the row budgets are measured over. Blank uses one day; an emptied budget refills gradually.

fields.label: Partner Read Rows/window
fields.description: Rows one partner may read each window. At 10,000 a day, a drained budget returns about 7 a minute.

fields.label: Partner Write Rows/window
fields.description: Rows one partner may create or update each window. Paced, never blocked until tomorrow. 0 removes it.

fields.label: Global Read Rows/window
fields.description: Rows all partners together may read each window, paced the same way as the partner budget. 0 removes it.

fields.label: Global Write Rows/window
fields.description: Rows all partners together may create or update each window. Paced, never blocked. 0 removes it.

fields.label: Bulk Max Records
fields.description: Records one bulk upload may carry. An upload carrying more records than this one is refused.

fields.label: List Max Page
fields.description: The most records one read may return, whether that read is one list page or one bulk read.

fields.label: Bulk Max Files
fields.description: Files one bulk upload may carry. Kept below records, because every file is scanned and then stored.

fields.label: List Default Page
fields.description: Records a read returns when the caller does not ask for a number of records to be returned.

fields.label: Download Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Seconds spent fetching a file from a partner's link before giving up and refusing that request.

fields.label: Download Max Size (MB)
fields.description: The largest file accepted from a partner's link, in megabytes. A file larger than this is refused.

fields.label: Idempotency Window (hours)
fields.description: Hours a request's saved answer is kept. A repeat within it gets the saved answer, not a second write.

fields.label: Job Size
fields.description: A second tier for large creates: a partner submits a job and is told when it finishes. Off until switched on.

fields.label: Inline Job Max Records
fields.description: Records accepted in one job sent as text. A job carrying more records than this one is refused.

fields.label: File Job Max Size (MB)
fields.description: The largest uploaded job file accepted, in megabytes. A larger file is refused before it is stored.

fields.label: File Job Max Records
fields.description: Records accepted in one uploaded file job. A file carrying more records than this one is refused.

fields.label: Jobs Per Partner
fields.description: Jobs one partner may have waiting or running. A further job is refused until one of them finishes.

fields.label: Chunk Size
fields.description: Records saved per batch while a job runs. Bigger finishes sooner; smaller loses less if a job stops.

fields.label: Max Queued Jobs
fields.description: Jobs that may be waiting or running across all partners. A job beyond this is asked to retry later.

fields.label: Job Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Seconds a single job may run. A job still running past this point is stopped and marked as failed.

fields.label: Partner Rows/day
fields.description: Rows one partner may write per day through background jobs, counted across every job they submit.

fields.label: Upload File Retention (days)
fields.description: Days a finished job's uploaded file is kept. The job and its per-record results stay after that.

fields.label: Global Rows/day
fields.description: Rows all partners together may write per day through background jobs, counted across every job.
